config.title: The whole room
config.description: Every student submits their true friends. Random status quo vs. the proposed system.

objective.formula: C = extra_weight * sum_i max(0, s_i - 1) + lambda * sum_pairs (m_w * m_ab + alpha_w * alpha_ab)
objective.hardConstraint: every obligated student shares a table with at least one present, eligible listed companion

solver.pipeline: pod greedy -> swap repair -> annealing -> CP-SAT (hinted, exact objective) with validated fallbacks

proposed.note: Distinct peers count students seated together; unlisted tablemates are not assumed unfamiliar. Exactly-one coverage is an optimisation statistic, not a wellbeing measure.

proposed.note: Descriptive only: recurring co-seating may reflect sincere preferences, forced structures, small eligible pools, or chance. It is not evidence of intent.

random.note: Descriptive only: recurring co-seating may reflect sincere preferences, forced structures, small eligible pools, or chance. It is not evidence of intent.

proposed.note: Fraction of obligated students whose most frequent tablemate is a listed peer. This inference needs no public cap and no complete archive; it is not a proof of any entry.
